title.narrative: Strengthening Resilience in Timor-Leste for Sustainable Development

description.narrative:
This workplan supports two complementary areas of action in Timor-Leste: advancing UNESCO’s Multidimensional Vulnerability Framework (MVF) and strengthening engagement with UNESCO’s initiative on the Centres of Excellence (CoE) in Marine Science and Biodiversity for Lusophone SIDS, currently under implementation in lusophone African SIDS.
The MVF component will support the preparation of a Timor-Leste profile using a UNESCO-specific framework which builds on the UN Multidimensional Vulnerability Index (MVI), assessing vulnerabilities, capacities and priorities across UNESCO’s areas of competence to inform programming, partnerships and resource mobilisation. The CoE component will support activities that strengthen national capacities, knowledge generation and collaboration in ocean science, biodiversity conservation and sustainable blue economy, including through engagement with the lusophone African SIDS already engaged in the initiatives, and other international partners.
